title: Sustained undervoltage at Node C
description: A heavy simulated load drops Node C to about 0.80 pu for 20 s, then the load is removed.
what_to_look_for: Node C turns amber 'Low – confirming', then 'Undervoltage' after the persistence time (placeholder 3 s).
One UNDERVOLTAGE event for Node C, not one per sample.
After the load is removed: RECOVERY CHECK with a 10 s stability timer, then RESTORED, then NORMAL; the event closes with an end time equal to the start of the stable window.

steps.note: Heavy load at Node C: voltage falls to about 0.80 pu
Load removed: Node C back to normal
